integrity: Apéry optimization, genus and conductor criteria and the density-one argument are proved in RESULT.md; underlying classical Gauss and Landau theorems are cited, not newly proved. No independent scientific review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: No sharp second-order genus term or finite congruence classification of exceptional conductors; finite checks are not proofs of asymptotics; an adjacent article was accessible only by abstract.
title: Apéry layers and a density-one sharp conductor for translated triangular-number semigroups
